inspection_scope: Pinned public metadata, documentation and one visualization source file only; not the archive contents or external unpublished calibration records

requirements.finding: Source versions pinned; the paper is a September 2026 arXiv posting of work attributed to SDF 2025.
requirements.needed_record: No identity gap for the inspected metadata; actual payload content is uninspected.

requirements.finding: All listed trajectory/mesh/sensor archives exceed both local source and artifact caps.
requirements.needed_record: A small provenance-bearing numeric extract for two identified actors; no media. No archive internals were inspected.

requirements.finding: Target-aligned scans and directional dimensions are documented; visualization code is not a measured footprint certificate.
requirements.needed_record: Both actual footprints or projected supports, INS output reference transforms, geometry/registration errors and ego geometry for the exact configuration.

requirements.finding: The datasheet distinguishes CEP position accuracy and axis-specific one-sigma angles; this is not a deterministic envelope.
requirements.needed_record: Unit/configuration/solution-mode bindings and calibrated joint pose errors or a justified simultaneous deterministic bound. The authors report a dedicated accuracy check, but its records were not obtained.

requirements.finding: Clock alignment is described; the manufacturer postprocessing timing statement is not bound to the dataset message chain.
requirements.needed_record: Timestamp origin, latency corrections, per-unit bias/drift/jitter and validity intervals, with evidence reducing them to the solver common-offset model or a newly frozen model.

requirements.finding: High-rate reference and interpolation are described; no physical rate bound is qualified in this review.
requirements.needed_record: A measured/justified bound covering translation and rotation between samples, dropout policy and horizon edges; sampled extrema alone are insufficient.

requirements.finding: Covariance fields and single-unit statistics do not establish a simultaneous two-actor whole-horizon coverage event.
requirements.needed_record: For a probabilistic study, calibration residuals, population, horizon, dependence, selection rules and coverage estimation uncertainty under a separately frozen protocol.

requirements.finding: The dataset host provides custom terms while GitHub says license on request; no transformed data is published.
requirements.needed_record: A retained rights basis for the exact intended extract and any redistribution. This metadata-only review proceeds with source bodies private.

review_authority: Same-session research interpretation; no operator acceptance, external calibration verification, legal compliance or independent scientific review
